description.value: Ricardo's is an ice cream shop on Granville Street in the heart of downtown Vancouver's entertainment district. The shop offers vegan-friendly options and air-conditioned indoor seating, making it a comfortable rest stop for cyclists in the area. Payments by credit and debit card are accepted.
